title: Mulk Raj Anand's birth chart
metaDescription: Mulk Raj Anand's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 19.6° Sagittarius. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Tightest of all, Mercury holds a sextile to Saturn at 0.3° — close enough to weld thinking to structure. A sextile is an offer rather than a given: available when it is reached for, quiet when it is not.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 19.6° of Sagittarius is the Sun's exact seat — second decan, 10°–20°, sub-ruled by Mars in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Mercury holds 27.9° Sagittarius, Venus holds 4.3° Sagittarius, Mars holds 18.3° Aquarius — in the old shorthand, thought that arrives already in motion; attraction declared rather than implied; effort aimed through strategy and words.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Mercury and Saturn — a sextile holding at 0.3°. A sextile pays out only on effort; the scheme calls it opportunity rather than gift. Behind it, the Sun sextile Mars at 1.3°, and Jupiter square Saturn at 1.4° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: No closed figure — no grand trine, t-square, or grand cross — holds among the day-stable angles. The chart distributes its tension pair by pair rather than through one standing structure.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks two placements here. Mercury in Sagittarius at 27.9° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Saturn in Aquarius at 27.7° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements air 4, fire 3, earth 2, water 1; modalities mutable 5, fixed 3, cardinal 2. Air signs carry exchange in the scheme — comparison, argument, the sentence that makes the situation legible. Mercury, Jupiter, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Gemini for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.3° between midnight and midnight. That is quick enough to make the exact degree a neighbourhood rather than an address, and slow enough to leave the sign settled. At the noon reference it stands at 23.4°.
